buyBody: Twenty-five tees with a clover on them. You are out of tees. You have been out of tees since March. This is nine dollars ninety-five.

four.v: The least you can spend here

details.headline: You are out of tees
paras: Everyone is always out of tees. They snap, they get left in the ground, they end up in a washing machine. It is the one golf product with a genuinely disposable life cycle.
Twenty-five in a pack. Put some in the bag and some in the car.

details.headline: Twenty-five of them
paras: A pack of twenty-five, clover-marked. Length and material are not published anywhere we can verify, so they are marked below rather than guessed at.

photoBrief: Flat-lay, square. A loose scatter of tees on a dark surface with the clover mark legible on at least three of them. This is the ONLY product in the store with no photograph in Shopify at all — the tile and the PDP both fall back to this slot until one exists.
